title: SEA partner roadshow ops scratchpad
content:
High-level: 3-city partner roadshow (SEA office -> partner HQs) 2024 Nov week of 11/4. Small booth + 2x demos + 1 executive dinner. This doc captures quick ops, expense reminders, local vendors, and oncall wallet notes.

Status quick view:
- Bookings: flights done for core team (Arjun, Lena). Priya pending (wait for final agenda)
- Hotel: Mariners Center (group block) 11/4-11/8, block code REDWOOD23 — confirm check-in times
- Booth: 6ft table + backdrop ordered from Seaside Events (see vendor below)
- Demos: demo VM snapshot v3.2 created by eng; shipping 1 laptop and dongles from office kit

Immediate TODOs (short checklist):
- [ ] Priya flight finalize by 2024-10-20 (approve $400 cap)
- [ ] Submit expense pre-approval for executive dinner (budget $2,000) -> Expense code EXP-GTM-DINNER
- [ ] Upload vendor invoices to Confluence page and tag accounting
- [ ] Print 50 one-pagers (marketing) — due 11/1 — vendor: PrintWave pickup option
- [ ] Onsite SIM / data eSIM for backup: buy 1 T-Mobile day pass (reimburse)

Expense rules / reminders (quick):
- Use company card for bookings where possible. If personal card used, capture card last 4 + copy of boarding pass + itemized receipt.
- Per-diem: standard US domestic per-diem $65/day meal cap (use EXP-PERD code). Conference entertainment over $75 per person needs prior approval.
- Taxi/ride-share: keep receipts. Use rideshare for gear transport if >2 bags.
- Tips: round to nearest dollar, include tip on receipt where possible.
- Foreign transactions: N/A (domestic), but still classify under EXP-TRVL if cross-state.

Receipts capture protocol (for quick expense ops):
- Take two photos: itemized + card slip. If receipt is paper-only, scan with phone (CamScanner) and upload to Concur within 48 hrs. Filename format: SEA-yyyymmdd-vendor-amount.
- Receipt backlog: any receipts >7 days outstanding — notify Arjun with Slack #expense-help.

Vendor & local contacts (call first, then email):
- Seaside Events (booth + backdrop + install) — main: Maya Ortiz — maya@seasideevents.co — (206) 555-0198. Install window 11/4 08:00–11:30; oncall tech: Javier (cell (206) 555-0122).
- PrintWave (rapid print + bind) — contact: Raj Patel — raj@printwave.io — turnaround 48 hrs, pickup at Ballard hub. PO required for >$500.
- Gear courier (day-of bump-in/out) — Pacific Handlers — dispatch@pacifichandlers.com — (206) 555-0104. Note: cargo insurance optional $12 flat.
- Catering (executive dinner) — Harbor Table — sales@harbortable.com — lead: Simone. Menu suggestions in Confluence page.

Onsite ops notes (day-of):
- Arrival window: team on site by 07:30 for load-in. Booth build checklist: table cloth, backdrop, laptop, power strip, HDMI, dongles, business cards, one-pagers.
- Power: venue provides 1 outlet per 6ft table — bring 2x 6ft extension + 1x power strip. Label CORDS with red tape.
- Demo laptop: image name REDWOOD-ROADSHOW-SEA-v3.2 — local user account 'redwood-demo' (pw: supplied via 1Password). Offline demo fallback: pre-recorded video and USB copy.
- Wifi: venue wifi is flaky. Bring LTE hotspot + eSIM. Test speed 24hrs before event.

Reimbursements: standard flow
1) Submit Concur expense report within 5 business days after event.
2) Attach receipts (see capture protocol).
3) Tag report with "SEA-ROADSHOW-2024" and relevant expense codes: EXP-TRVL, EXP-PERD, EXP-GTM-DINNER, EXP-EQUIP.
4) Manager approval: Lena -> Finance (Ava Kim). Expect reimbursement within 10 business days after approval.

Approvals and policy flags:
- Any single meal > $120 requires director approval.
- Equipment purchases > $1,000 must go through procurement (submit PR to procurement@redwood.com).

Contingencies / last-minute decisions:
- If demo laptop fails: use backup laptop + recorded demo. If internet fails and hotspot insufficient, run local containerized demo (eng oncall is aware).
- If booth vendor delays >30m, escalate to Maya and then call Pacific Handlers for temporary staffing.

Post-event (wrap) checklist:
- [ ] Debrief notes uploaded to Confluence (owner: Arjun) within 3 days
- [ ] Expense report submitted by all attendees
- [ ] Lead capture CSV exported and uploaded to CRM (Priya)
- [ ] Return rented items and confirm invoicing -> attach to Confluence

Notes to self / messy bits:
- Consider prepaid per-diem cards next run to avoid small cash reimbursements.
- Check if PrintWave can quote a last-minute 100 card with QR code for demo signups.
- Who's carrying HDMI adapter? Tom? confirm in Slack.
- Confirm whether partner wants thank-you swag (stickers ok, no electronics).

Useful links quick: Confluence brief, demo VM repo, travel policy (linked above). Slack: #partner-roadshow (use for live day updates).

Questions open:
- Final headcount for exec dinner by 10/22? (Priya?)
- Approver for any overages >$500 per category (need clear signoff)

End of scratchpad. Keep informal notes here during prep — will move finalized items into Confluence checklist after 10/22.
